def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); from collections import Counter
 bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
 coords=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
 cnt=Counter(grid[r][c] for r,c in coords); mark=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
 ex=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r,c in coords if grid[r][c]!=mark]
 mr=(min(r for r,c,v in ex)+max(r for r,c,v in ex))//2; mc=(min(c for r,c,v in ex)+max(c for r,c,v in ex))//2
 pat=[(r-mr,c-mc,v) for r,c,v in ex]
 out=[row[:] for row in grid]
 for r,c in coords:
  if grid[r][c]==mark:
   for dr,dc,v in pat:
    rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
    if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=v
 return out
